decisions.reason: Single-case EM of colloid cyst wall (squamous plus mucin-secreting columnar epithelium) argues non-neuroepithelial origin, weighing against a paraphyseal/neuroepithelial origin (clinical).
Epiplexus cells on turtle embryonic choroid epithelium; generic choroid plexus cytology, no paraphysis link.
Case of mixed colloid cyst-xanthogranuloma; EM describes epithelial cell types but abstract gives no histogenetic conclusion or paraphysis reference.
Paraphysectomy of bullfrog tadpoles: parathyroid hyperplasia and fractures 22 months later; experimental data on paraphysis function (calcium metabolism).
Aminergic/cholinergic innervation of amphibian choroid plexus in three species; no paraphysis or dorsal-midline roof comparison in abstract.
Case report of colloid cysts in twins; no histogenesis or paraphysis content.

Human stage 11: defines telencephalon medium as the embryonic lamina terminalis (rostral neuropore closure); terminology baseline for locating the human paraphysis (ontogeny); weak link, no paraphysis mention.
Circadian amine rhythms in the turtle 'pineal-paraphyseal complex' measured as combined tissue; paraphysis not analysed separately, so only contextual physiology.
Pigeon subfornical organ lesion and drinking; functional circumventricular organ study, no paraphysis link.
Paraphysectomy (paraphyseal-choroid plexus complex removal) in adult bullfrogs stimulates parathyroids; experimental physiology/histology of the paraphysis.
Comparative survey of circumventricular organs: states paraphysis present in dogfish and osteoglossomorph teleosts and that the lungfish 'paraphysis' is a dorsal sac (phylogeny/terminology).
Subcommissural organ vascular/leptomeningeal projections in snake and turtle; SCO paper with no comparison to paraphysis.
Fatal colloid cyst case; 'paraphyseal cyst' appears only as a synonym, no analysis or argument on paraphyseal origin.
Human stage 12 brain; only notes telencephalon medium enlarged, nothing locating the paraphysis.
Freeze-fracture of rat ependyma and circumventricular organs; no paraphysis link.
Reserpine/chlorpromazine effects on amines in turtle 'pineal-paraphyseal complex' (combined tissue, paraphysis not separated); contextual physiology only.
Immunohistochemical subdivisions of lungfish telencephalon (pallium/subpallium homologies); abstract has no roof, dorsal sac or paraphysis content.
Immunoperoxidase of 8 colloid cysts supports endodermal origin, bearing on whether a paraphyseal (neuroepithelial) origin is tenable (clinical).
Light/EM review of benign CNS cyst walls; colloid cysts usually neuroectodermal but features suggest endodermal origin, relevant to weighing the paraphyseal hypothesis (clinical).
Immunohistochemical panel of 14 intracranial cysts for diagnosis; only one colloid cyst, no histogenesis argument or paraphysis link.
Colloid cyst case report; EM (microvilli with coating) used to argue endodermal origin; low-weight histogenesis evidence (clinical).
NPY mapping in chick brain; 'subseptal (subfornical) organ' terminology only, no paraphysis link.
Parietal eye masking and body temperature in Varanus; parietal eye is not the paraphysis (metadata only, title unambiguous).
Human stage 13 brain; names adult lamina terminalis and commissural plate but nothing locating the paraphysis or roof.
Human stage 14: telencephalon medium and site of the velum transversum (roof thickness change) define the boundary region where the human paraphysis would arise (ontogeny).
Circadian and photoperiod effects on amines in turtle 'pineal-paraphyseal complex' (combined tissue, paraphysis not separated); contextual physiology only.
Chick pineal cytodifferentiation; pineal only, no paraphysis link.
Bird vs mammal ADH/ANGII review including subfornical organ; no paraphysis link.
Sturgeon telencephalic choroid plexus vascular casting incl. dorsal-sac vessels; abstract never relates dorsal sac to paraphysis or homology.
SEM of supraependymal cells in chicken third ventricle; no paraphysis link.
Fourth-ventricle colloid cyst argued to share neuroepithelial origin with third-ventricle cysts via roof development; bears on whether a paraphysis-specific origin can hold (clinical/ontogeny).

Colloid-cyst immunohistochemistry explicitly weighs embryonic paraphysis vs tela choroidea vs choroid plexus/ependyma origins; concludes cysts are a primitive neuroectoderm anomaly distinct from choroid plexus.
Holoprosencephaly/cyclopia embryos with absent mediobasal telencephalon; ventral midline, not the roof or paraphysis.
Human stage 16 brain; hemispheres and interventricular foramen, no roof or paraphysis content in abstract.
Human stage 17: choroid plexus anlage begins in the roof of telencephalon medium (vessels, necrosis, anterior choroid artery); locates the tela choroidea region adjoining the paraphysis (ontogeny).
Ambient temperature effects on amines in turtle 'pineal-paraphyseal complex' (combined tissue, paraphysis not separated); contextual physiology only.
Intraspinal genuine endodermal epithelial cyst; spinal case, no link to third-ventricle or paraphyseal origin.
Review of intrapineal neuronal organisation in fish and amphibians (snippet only); pineal complex, no paraphysis content seen.
HT7 blood-brain-barrier marker in chick circumventricular organs; no paraphysis link.
Familial colloid cysts in two brothers; cell-of-origin controversy only mentioned, no histogenesis data or paraphysis discussion.
Lacertilian parietal eye ganglion cells; parietal eye, not paraphysis.
Vascular casting and TEM of frog paraphysis: sinusoidal portal bed fed by choroid plexus, fenestrated endothelium, possible calcium-metabolism role.
Ultrastructure of treefrog paraphysis, anterior choroid plexus and endolymphatic tubules; proposed functional unit regulating CSF composition.
Letter 'Ontogenesis of colloid cysts' (Kondziolka), no abstract; MeSH choroid plexus/immunohistochemistry. Reading the letter text would show whether it argues for or against a paraphyseal origin.

Human stages 18-20 (7th week) with choroid plexuses; abstract mentions only fourth/lateral ventricle plexuses, so whether the full text describes the paraphysis or telencephalon medium roof cannot be judged. Full text would resolve it.
Sarcopterygian telencephalon chapter (web snippet, title only); unclear whether it treats the lungfish roof, dorsal sac or paraphysis. Chapter text on the roof/dorsal sac would resolve it.
